name: Dynamic simulation and operator training simulators
principle: Dynamic simulation solves the plant's mass, energy and momentum balances over time rather than at steady state, reproducing transient behaviour: relief events, compressor surging, furnace trip response, control-loop interaction. The same high-fidelity model, connected to a replica of the plant DCS graphics, becomes an operator training simulator that lets crews rehearse startups, shutdowns and emergencies offline before touching the real unit.

process_steps.name: Steady-state or first-principles model built from P&IDs and heat/material balance
Model made dynamic: holds, lags, controller actions, equipment limits
Tuned against plant history so transients reproduce observed behaviour
Connected to a DCS-replica operator station for training scenarios
Used for control checkout, procedure trials and operator certification
